name: Cel-shaded sky adventure
one_line: Bright grass, big clouds and islands in a blue sky.
look_words: A bright adventure high in the sky. Vivid grass green, warm stone and sandy paths under a deep blue sky stacked with big white clouds; floating islands, waterfalls, windmills and rope bridges. Everything is shaded in two flat tones with a crisp edge between light and shadow and a thin dark outline. Shadows are blue-violet, never grey. The sun is high and clear. Yellow marks things to collect, violet the goal, red is harm, and the player wears white so it shows against grass and sky. Motion is lively: wind in the grass, cloth flapping, clouds sliding past, quick snappy jumps. Avoid muddy colours, soft realistic shading, fog that dulls the sky and bloom.

palette.name: bright sky
palette.notes: Below the horizon the sky is nearly white: it reads as a floor of cloud under the islands.

upgrade.why: flat clean colour, heaped clouds and an inked outline in the style of hand-painted film backgrounds
